retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic composition featuring a central monolithic geometric frame over a glowing futuristic cityscape and starry nebula, anchored by small silhouettes.
excludeWhen: organic or naturalistic landscapes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, dark-themed composition where a large, sharp-edged geometric diamond frame glows with a golden aura, bisecting a starry space nebula and a blue-lit futuristic city skyline. Two small human silhouettes stand on a dark, rocky foreground ridge, providing scale to the massive central typography and geometric elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Central diamond frame containing the primary focal point
Scale contrast between tiny silhouettes and massive monolithic type
Color temperature split between warm nebula (top) and cool city lights (bottom)
Symmetrical balance centered on the vertical axis
coreInvariants: Grainy, film-like texture across the entire image
Glowing golden stroke on the geometric diamond
Deep blue and cyan illumination for the city skyline

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Massive central typography dominates the middle third; small silhouettes at the bottom center provide scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing golden diamond frame that encompasses the central logo and city.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright nebula top-right, follows the diamond down to the silhouettes, then moves up to the large central text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense starry space at the top corners provides breathing room for the central elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep space black and navy blue for the background and foreground.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan and electric blue for the city lights and lower atmosphere.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow and orange for the nebula and diamond glow.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright white text/glows and the dark, textured landscape.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cyan, gold, and monochromatic tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif with heavy block weights
letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke width for the main logo
Interlocking or overlapping glyphs that form a single monolithic block
Diagonal cuts that follow the angle of the central diamond
characterSpecificRedesigns: N and O terminals are cut at 45-degree angles to match the diamond frame
E and R share vertical strokes to create a compact unit
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Massive custom geometric block lettering paired with ultra-condensed, wide-tracked sans-serif for credits.

preserve: Angular cuts on the main logo
Wide tracking on the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: For the condensed metadata block at the bottom
The main logo requires specific geometric alignment with the diamond frame

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, grainy sci-fi landscape with a rocky foreground, two small silhouettes, a glowing blue city in the midground, and a starry nebula with a golden diamond frame in the sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, white, custom geometric block logo in the center and a block of condensed, wide-tracked white text at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the central logo white and monolithic?
Does the diamond frame have a golden glow?
Are the silhouettes small enough to create a sense of scale?
Is the film grain texture visible across all elements?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the diamond frame strokes
mustRedesign: Artist names in the credit block
Unique character ligatures from the source logo

mustAchieve: Sharp geometric precision in the frame
avoid: Soft or blurry edges on typography

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly centered horizontally
Check that the golden glow doesn't wash out the white text
Verify the silhouettes are distinct against the city glow
Confirm the shooting star streak is subtle and diagonal
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a massive geometric focal point with a dual-tone (warm/cool) cosmic landscape and high-density condensed metadata.
